description: This file defines a factory class 'ControlFlowFactory' for creating message objects with sender information in an Akka-based control flow system. It provides a static method to bundle a message with its sender, utilizing generics and external classes.

classes.name: ControlFlowFactory
classes.description: A utility factory class for creating 'WithSender' message objects, preventing instantiation by private constructor that throws AssertionError.

methods.name: messageWithSender
methods.description: Creates a 'WithSender' object by wrapping a message of generic type T (extending WithDittoHeaders) with its sender ActorRef, returning an immutable instance.
